description: This Kotlin source file defines the PlayerActivity class, an Android activity that provides media playback functionality using ExoPlayer tailored for Android TV. It manages initialization and release of the media player according to Android lifecycle conventions, handles user input for playback control, and sets up the activity layout with necessary focus and screen-on flags.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity utilizing ExoPlayer for media playback tailored for Android TV, managing playback lifecycle, user input, and fullscreen playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and configures the PlayerView for focus.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the ExoPlayer instance if SDK version >= 24.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Initializes the ExoPlayer if SDK version < 24 or if not already initialized.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the player if SDK version < 24 to conserve resources.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases the player if SDK version >= 24.

methods.name: initializePlayerIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates and prepares the ExoPlayer instance with media URL received via intent.

methods.name: releasePlayer
methods.description: Releases and nullifies the ExoPlayer instance.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events to toggle play/pause on D-Pad center press.
